name: terminal_input_timing_v1
purpose: Evaluate the same terminal receiving-hand position from input windows at different times
source: corrected v3 terminal_endpose_learned, validation-selected best_intention checkpoints
primary_windows: non-overlapping blocks 0-59,60-119,... relative to the first annotated handover master row; incomplete final blocks omitted
secondary_windows: all original frozen 60-sample windows with stride 10 and a ground-truth handover endpoint, including pre-handover context
time_origin: annotated handover onset, not measured physical arm-motion onset; rows are aligned sensor samples, not necessarily raw video frames
primary_regime: endpoint strictly before the first physical hand capture used in terminal target aggregation
diagnostic_regime: endpoint inside target aggregation interval, reported separately as partially observed state estimation
excluded: endpoints at/after the final target capture; rejected terminal targets; missing either hand reference
comparison: learned predicted-hand and persistence predicted-hand on identical windows; GT-hand learned/persistence diagnostics also reported
aggregation: per-seed window mean plus per-seed equal-recording mean; mean and sample SD across seeds; counts of windows and recordings; changing cohort sizes explicitly shown
selection: no retraining, no new checkpoint or hyperparameter selection
limitations: Post-hoc analysis of previously observed held-out participants Edu, Jona, Mona
Only old original videos and the terminal model; recent t+1 fine-tuning results are a separate task
Time-dependent aggregate curves can change because different recordings contribute to different bins
Annotated handover onset is a proxy for the start of arm movement
Whole-recording robot calibration remains offline; seed SD is not participant uncertainty
